question: The first day of the Tamil calendar on 14 April is celebrated as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Puthandu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Puthandu **is also known as T**amil New Year's Day **and is celebrated on the first day of the** Tamil month of Chithirai. **
 
• The festival is observed by Tamils all over the world and is a time for **family gatherings, feasting, and exchanging gifts.**
 
• It is thought that **Lord Indra **arrived to earth on this auspicious day to bring about **harmony and tranquility**.
 
• It's also thought that **Lord Brahma **started the universe's creation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahamaham** is a festival celebrated in **Tamil Nadu** once every **12 years **at the** Mahamaham tank** in **Kumbakonam**.

 
 
• It is believed that taking a **dip in the tank d**uring the festival will wash away all sins and lead to salvation.
 
 
 
• **Onam** is a** harvest festival **celebrated in** Kerala** in honor of **King Mahabali**.
 
 
• It is a **ten-day festival **that falls in the Malayalam month of **Chingam** and is marked by feasting, boat races, and cultural programs.
 
 
 
• **Pongal** is a harvest festival celebrated in **Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana**.
 
 
• It is a** four-day** festival that falls in the Tamil month of **Thai** and is marked by the cooking of **sweet rice dishes** and the drawing of **Kolams** (rangoli) on the floor.
